descStruct.summary: **🎠「銀河の空間メッシュ」の幾何・粒子・乱数種をそのままに、法則だけを geoPN=4 のトイ測地線モードへ替えた原理コピー**(第265便b・第57報「ブラックホール連星、星団、銀河の検証をアナロジーとして進める」)。重力(E4)はそのままで、E6′ の引きずりと E12 の 1PN は**当たらない**(geoPN=4 は E6′・1PN・座標変換慣性と排他 — 重複適用禁止)。代わりに、自己を除いた正規化平均のフレーム速度 ū=η·u を使う作用 L=½m|v−ū|²−mΦ から出る a=∂ₜū+(∇ū)v−(∇ū)ᵀ(v−ū) を、粒子とメッシュの運動量を同時更新する契約で当てる(第259便a の HP.dfmGeoToyStep)。宣言は lawVersion:"scalar"(大域の正規化平均)・η=toyGain=1(既定)・kFrame=0(トイの入場条件)である。**これは較正ではない**: 観測回転曲線は 1 つも入力しておらず、claim 窓も regression window も 1 つも張っていない。**🎠 本体(geoPN=0・kFrame=1)は 1 bit も動かない。****中心核は pinned(規定運動)**なので、トイが ∂ₜu へ渡す源の加速度は規定運動の加速度(静止核では厳密に 0)である — 第264便b ① の修正が**内蔵に届く最初の経路**がこの本である。第265便b の mesh-v2(引きずりの完全置換の候補・最小代数実装)は **2 体でしか検証していない**ので、この本には当てていない。
descStruct.observe: 実測(器 tests/exp-w265b-galaxy.mjs・dt=0.016・351 体・seed 20260910・T=48=3000 步): ①**保持率**(**指数円盤 260 粒だけ**のうち r ≤ R_ref にいる割合。R_ref=t=0 の円盤粒子の最大半径=259.5872)は 3000 步で 0.996154。🎠 本体(geoPN=0・kFrame=1)は 1.000000、同じ初期条件の geoPN=2・kFrame=0 は 0.984615 である。②**V_rms**(同じ円盤粒子)は 5.223972(本体 7.351029・geoPN=2 側 3.905560)。〔第264便b ③〕の 7.63430 等は**全粒子**の窓なので直接は比べられない(窓が違う)。**この 3 つのどれが「正しい」かは、この表からは言えない**(比べる観測量が 1 つも無い — 較正はしていない)。③**円盤だけの v_φ(r)**(中心核とバルジ 90 粒を外し、指数円盤 260 粒だけを R_ref の 0.1/0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0 倍・幅 ±12.5% の 5 帯で見る)と σ_R(同じ帯の動径速度の標準偏差)を PHYSICS〔第265便b〕④ の表に置いた。**全粒子の半質量半径は指標にしない**(中心質量が支配するので円盤の話にならない)。④**刻み依存**: 同じ終了時刻 T=9.6 を dt=0.016/0.008/0.004 で走らせると、円盤の V_rms は本サンプルで 5.377020/5.376440/5.314906、🎠 本体で 7.283439/7.231572/7.242114 と動く(**どちらも非単調**)。v_φ(0.5R_ref) は 4.1532/4.1533/4.1538(本サンプル)で 4 桁一致する。**単純外挿しない。**⑤健全性: NaN 0・トイの帳簿は E_toy+E_mesh=0(厳密)。⑥**言わないこと**: **銀河を較正した/回転曲線を再現した/腕が描けた=較正/引きずりを完全置換した**とは書かない(T4)。観測 v(r) の門を持つのは 🛞 だけで、σ は接続していない。

descStruct.summary: A PRINCIPLE COPY OF 🎠 'GALAXY SPACE MESH' WITH THE SAME GEOMETRY, PARTICLES AND RANDOM SEED, AND ONLY THE LAW SWAPPED FOR THE geoPN=4 TOY GEODESIC MODE (wave 265b, report 57: 'carry the black-hole binary, star cluster and galaxy checks forward as analogies'). Gravity (E4) is unchanged, while the E6-prime dragging and the E12 1PN term DO NOT ACT (geoPN=4 is exclusive with E6-prime, 1PN and the coordinate inertia - no double application). In their place the toy applies a = d/dt u-bar + (grad u-bar)v - (grad u-bar)^T (v - u-bar), derived from L = 1/2 m |v - u-bar|^2 - m Phi with u-bar = eta u the self-excluded normalised average frame velocity, updating the particle and mesh momenta in the same step (HP.dfmGeoToyStep, wave 259a). The declarations are lawVersion scalar, eta = toyGain = 1 (the default) and kFrame = 0 (the toy's entry condition). THIS IS NOT A CALIBRATION: no observed rotation curve is fed in, and not one claim window or regression window is declared. 🎠 ITSELF (geoPN=0, kFrame=1) IS BIT-UNCHANGED. THE NUCLEUS IS PINNED (prescribed motion), so the source acceleration handed to the toy's d/dt u is the prescribed one (exactly zero for a nucleus at rest) - this sample is THE FIRST BUILT-IN PATH on which wave 264b's fix acts at all. Wave 265b's mesh-v2 (the candidate full replacement, a minimal algebraic implementation) IS VERIFIED FOR TWO BODIES ONLY and is therefore not applied here.
descStruct.observe: Measured (harness tests/exp-w265b-galaxy.mjs, dt=0.016, 351 bodies, seed 20260910, T=48 = 3000 steps). (1) RETENTION (the fraction of the 260 EXPONENTIAL-DISC particles inside R_ref, the initial maximum disc radius 259.5872) is 0.996154 at 3000 steps; 🎠 itself (geoPN=0, kFrame=1) gives 1.000000 and the geoPN=2, kFrame=0 control gives 0.984615. (2) V_rms over the same disc particles is 5.223972 against 7.351029 (🎠) and 3.905560 (geoPN=2). The 7.63430 of wave 264b section 3 uses the ALL-PARTICLE window and is not directly comparable. WHICH OF THE THREE IS 'RIGHT' CANNOT BE SAID FROM THIS TABLE - there is not one observable to compare against, and nothing is calibrated. (3) v_phi(r) OF THE DISC ONLY (the nucleus and the 90 bulge particles are excluded; only the 260 exponential-disc particles are binned at 0.1 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0 of R_ref with a half-width of 12.5%) and sigma_R (the standard deviation of the radial velocity in the same bands) are tabulated in PHYSICS, wave 265b, section 4. THE HALF-MASS RADIUS OF ALL PARTICLES IS NOT USED as an indicator (the central mass dominates it). (4) STEP DEPENDENCE: at the same end time T=9.6 with dt = 0.016 / 0.008 / 0.004 the disc V_rms reads 5.377020 / 5.376440 / 5.314906 here and 7.283439 / 7.231572 / 7.242114 on 🎠 itself - BOTH NON-MONOTONIC - while v_phi(0.5 R_ref) holds at 4.1532 / 4.1533 / 4.1538. DO NOT EXTRAPOLATE NAIVELY. (5) Health: zero NaN; the toy ledger closes with E_toy + E_mesh = 0 exactly. (6) WHAT THIS DOES NOT CLAIM: not a calibrated galaxy, not a reproduced rotation curve, not 'the arms came out, therefore calibrated', not a complete replacement of the dragging (T4). Only 🛞 carries an observed v(r) gate, and sigma is not connected.
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B runs D0=500 (chi to 0), which all but switches the toy off. Raising D0 in the parameter row lowers chi and weakens the toy; lowering it strengthens the toy. DO NOT MOVE kFrame: it is the toy's entry condition, so any value other than 0 shows geoToy:denied in the step accounting and the dynamics run exactly as geoPN=2. The comparison partner is 🎠 (same initial conditions, geoPN=0, kFrame=1).

descStruct.summary: THE FIRST GALAXY ANALOGY - a geoPN=4 principle sample with a DFM black hole of declared scale at the centre, a stellar disc, and representative particles of stellar-mass optical-camouflage dwarfs (DR) (wave 282d, the originator's ruling in report 72, item 6). The physics is geoPN=4, kFrame=0, spaceMesh lawVersion scalar, eta=1, D0=1.5, eps=3, frameWeight share, and three points are declared: (1) the stellar masses (bulge 90 + disc 80) are fixed at 0.3125 so that M_star = 53.125 units is a declared value; (2) THE OPTICAL-CAMOUFLAGE DWARFS ARE A DYNAMICAL MASS COMPONENT - N_rep = 40 representative particles x 53.125 = M_DR = 2125 units (<m_DR> = 1 Msun as the representative, N_DR = 20 N_star declared, M_DR/M_star = 40 independent of units), on the stellar disc's exponential distribution (declared - a decision item), started on the circular-orbit solution of the placed potential (vMode enclosed); (3) spaceMesh centerSpin read lets the toy field read the centre's spin (the E6-prime decay form omega(d)=s(R/(R+d))^q, q=2). Gravity (E4) and the geoPN=4 toy (coordinate inertia) act. f=1 (no mass correction). NO OBSERVED ROTATION CURVE IS FED IN (not a calibration; no claim or regression window). WHAT THIS DOES NOT CLAIM: a reproduced flat rotation curve, a calibrated galaxy, optical-camouflage dwarfs detected as free-floating planets. As of wave 289 this sample does not run on the inertial-determinacy kernel of the report-79 restatement (DFM restatement and corrections: relative motion x m/r^2, near/far side); it runs on the share p=1 field with q, and the chain is a hypothesis.
descStruct.observe: Measured (harness tests/exp-w282d-analogy.mjs, canonical tests/out/analogy-w282d.json, dt=0.016): the rotation curve v_c(r) from the actual gravitational acceleration of the declared configuration at r=20/40/80/120/240/480, in four columns - no DR / 0.1 / 1 / 10 Msun (numbers in the table of PHYSICS, wave 282d - NOT compared with any observation). The response to the centre's spin: two runs of the same configuration with centre spin 1.2 and 0 differ (particle positions; d u_phi / d Omega_core per radial bin). Health over T=48 (3000 steps): zero NaN, the toy ledger closes E_toy + E_mesh = 0 exactly, and the retention of the 80 disc particles and of the 40 DR particles is in the canonical file. WHAT THIS DOES NOT CLAIM: a reproduced flat rotation curve, a calibrated galaxy.
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B sets THE CENTRE'S SPIN TO 0 (same configuration, same opt-in - only the centre's spin contribution is removed). DO NOT MOVE kFrame (the geoPN=4 entry condition).

raw.description: **🌚 の中心の自転軸を公転面に対し 90° 倒した原理コピー**(第288便e・原仮定者の裁定〔第78報〕⑦)。🌚 を書き換えずに写し、中心 DFM 版 BH の自転の置き場だけを替えた: 殻の spin 1.2 を 0 にし、同じ大きさの角運動量(|J|=337500)を親子コア(コア V2)に傾き 90°(面内)・方位 0 で置き、方位を宣言した歳差 Ω_p=0.12 で回す(core.axisMode:"prescribed" —— 規定運動であって力学ではない)。Ω_p は宣言値で、DFM から導出した値ではない(銀河の観測は無い —— アナロジー)。**現行法則では面内の引きずりは 0 のまま**: geoPN=4 のトイ(spaceMesh.centerSpin:"read")が読む中心の自転は殻 spin だけで、コアの J は向きに依らず読まれない。働くのは重力(E4)と geoPN=4 のトイ(座標慣性)で、2D の空間引きずり(A8/E6′)は 🌚 と同じく kFrame=0 で切ってある。「歳差が担う引きずり」は候補の診断量として器の中だけで測り、場には足さない。**言わないこと**: 引きずりが戻った/90° で銀河を回した/2D の腕を渦伸長と呼ぶ。第79報の整理(DFM の整理と修正)の慣性決定力の核(相対移動×m/r²・手前/反対)では、第289便の時点ではこの本は走っていない(走っているのは share p=1 の q 付き場で、連鎖は仮説)。実測(器 tests/exp-w288e-tilt90.mjs・正本 tests/out/tilt90-w288e.json・dt=0.016・T=48): 中心の J_z は 2.07×10⁻¹¹(機械ゼロ)。粒子の位置と速度は T=48 まで「🌚 の中心 spin=0」とビット一致し、歳差 0/宣言値/2 倍でも一致する(トイは中心の殻 spin だけを読む)。t=0 の η_mesh(符号つき)で中心の自転の寄与を分けると、🌚 では 内側の bin [0,20) から −0.260/−0.188/−0.130/−0.073/−0.067(内向き) で、この本は 0。候補の立体核(中心コアを半高 7.5 の円柱として層に分ける・β=G/c²)では、自転の部分の面内成分は上下の層で打ち消し(層の和/層ごとの最大 ≤ 1.3×10⁻¹³)、歳差の部分だけが面内に残る(r=20 の環平均 u_φ 5.10×10⁻³・層数 16→32 の相対変化 1.6×10⁻⁴・Ω_p に線形)。軸は宣言どおり方位を回し、面外の角運動量は拘束の帳簿(axPresc)へ記帳される。ワンタップ対照A/B: B 側は**中心の殻 spin=1.2 を戻す**(🌚 と同じ z の自転 —— コアの横倒しの軸はそのまま)。比較の相手は 🌚(軸が立った中心)。共通設定「コア軸の投影線を表示」で中心の軸の 2D 投影(面内に倒れた最長の線)が歳差で回るのが見える。**kFrame は動かさないこと**(geoPN=4 の入場条件)。

descStruct.summary: **🛸 の中心を親子コアの層に置き直した診断コピー**(第289便e・原仮定者の裁定〔第79報〕AN105/AN106・統括の検証項目 R123)。🛸 を書き換えずに写し、中心 DFM 版 BH のコア V2(傾き 90°・方位 0・宣言した歳差 Ω_p=0.12)だけを、変換 HP.coreV2ToLayers と同じ 2 層(コア層 m=750・r=7.5・J ベクトル (J_x,J_y,J_z)=(337500,0,0)・tilt 90・precessionRate 0.12/殻層 m=1750・r=15)に置き換えた。**コア V2 は持たない**(🛸 のコア V2 はそのまま残る —— V2 は消していない)。**契約: 層は J の z 射影だけを読む** —— 層の軸(傾き・方位・歳差)は数値として載り、表示(コア軸の投影線と同じ見た目)と移行の往復に使うだけで、力・減光・熱には入らない。働くのは 🛸 と同じ重力(E4)と geoPN=4 のトイ(中心の殻 spin だけを読む)で、2D の空間引きずりは kFrame=0 で切ってある。ただし層は**質量分布**でもあるので、半径 15 の内側に入った粒子には殻定理の差分(S._layerForce)が当たり、🛸 とはそこで食い違う。**言わないこと**: 層が V2 を置き換えた/引きずりが戻った/歳差を接続した。
descStruct.observe: 実測(器 tests/exp-w289e-tilt90layers.mjs・正本 tests/out/tilt90layers-w289e.json・dt=0.016・T=48・步ごとの状態の指紋): 層の軸を変えた対照(J を z に立てる・層の J と軸の宣言を外す・歳差 0/2 倍・方位 90°)は、すべて 3000 步の全步でこの本とビット一致する —— 層は J の z 射影だけを読み、軸・歳差は力に入らない(この構成では geoPN=4 のトイが中心の殻 spin だけを読むので、J_z も力に入らない)。🛸 とは步 39(t=0.624)から食い違い、これは半径 15 の内側に最初の粒子が入って層の近傍キック(殻定理の差分 S._layerForce)が当たった步と同じである。器の中だけで S._layerForce を外した対照は T=48 まで 🛸(=🌚 の中心 spin 0)と全步ビット一致する。差の大きさは T=24 で位置差の最大 97.5・rms 30.7、T=48 で最大 154.7・rms 41.3(層の近傍キックは 3000 步のうち 2962 步に入る)。殻 spin 1.2 を戻した B 側も、差分を外すと 🌚 と全步ビット一致する。層の J ベクトルは回らず、表示の方位だけが φ₀+Ω_p·t で回る(T=48 で 330.0°)。

descStruct.summary: A DIAGNOSTIC COPY OF 🛸 WITH THE CENTRE RE-PLACED AS PARENT-CHILD CORE LAYERS (wave 289e, the originator's ruling in report 79, AN105/AN106, the coordinator's check item R123). 🛸 is copied untouched and only the central DFM black hole's Core V2 (tilt 90 degrees, azimuth 0, declared precession Omega_p=0.12) is replaced by the same two layers that HP.coreV2ToLayers produces (core layer m=750, r=7.5, J vector (J_x,J_y,J_z)=(337500,0,0), tilt 90, precessionRate 0.12; shell layer m=1750, r=15). NO CORE V2 IS KEPT (🛸's Core V2 stays as it is - V2 is not removed). CONTRACT: LAYERS READ ONLY THE Z PROJECTION OF J - the layer axis (tilt, azimuth, precession) is carried as numbers and used for display (the same look as the core-axis projection) and for the migration round trip; it enters no force, dimming or heat. Gravity (E4) and the geoPN=4 toy (which reads only the centre's shell spin) act as in 🛸, and the 2D frame dragging is off with kFrame=0. The layers are also a MASS DISTRIBUTION, however, so particles inside radius 15 receive the shell-theorem difference (S._layerForce), and that is where this copy departs from 🛸. NOT CLAIMED: layers replaced V2, dragging restored, precession connected.
descStruct.observe: Measured (harness tests/exp-w289e-tilt90layers.mjs, canonical tests/out/tilt90layers-w289e.json, dt=0.016, T=48, a state fingerprint at every step): every control that changes the layer axis (J moved to z, layer J and axis declarations removed, precession 0 / 2x, azimuth 90 degrees) is bit-identical to this sample at all 3000 steps - layers read only the z projection of J, and the axis and precession enter no force (in this setup the geoPN=4 toy reads only the centre's shell spin, so even J_z enters no force). It departs from 🛸 at step 39 (t=0.624), the same step at which the first particle comes inside radius 15 and the near-field layer kick (the shell-theorem difference S._layerForce) is applied. A control that removes S._layerForce inside the harness only is bit-identical to 🛸 (= 🌚 with centre spin 0) at every step up to T=48. The size of the difference: maximum position difference 97.5 and rms 30.7 at T=24, maximum 154.7 and rms 41.3 at T=48 (the near-field layer kick acts on 2962 of the 3000 steps). Side B with the shell spin 1.2 put back is also bit-identical to 🌚 at every step once the difference is removed. The layer's J vector does not turn; only the displayed azimuth turns as phi0+Omega_p*t (330.0 degrees at T=48).
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B PUTS BACK THE CENTRE'S SHELL SPIN 1.2 (the same z spin as 🌚 - the layer's tipped axis stays). The comparison partners are 🛸 (the same axis held by a Core V2) and 🌚 (the upright centre). With the common setting 'Show the core axis projection' the 2D projection of the central layer's axis (the longest line, lying in plane) turns with the declared precession (display only - the layer's J is not rotated). DO NOT MOVE kFrame (the geoPN=4 entry condition).

descStruct.summary: FROM WAVE 297a (the originator's ruling, report 87; R161) pn is off and lambda_PN=0 (the pn reference-1PN wording below is the declaration until wave 296). A DIAGNOSTIC COPY: the physics and bodies of the old-input Pluto–Charon two-body (a=1.9596e7 m, e=0) are copied (kFrame=0) and ONLY THE LAW is swapped for the geoPN=4 velocity decomposition (lawVersion vMinusU) (wave 280c; the originator's ruling, report 70: 'examine the periapsis-advance differences - proceed as geoPN=3'). The external field is THE SAME SOLAR BACKGROUND as wave 279c's harness (the point mass evaluated at t=0 at the pair's barycentre, comoving - u=A/W is 4740 m/s along y), under mutual 0. The bodies' vx, vy are read as OBSERVED COORDINATE VELOCITIES xdot (velocityMeaning xdot) and converted at build to the inertial velocity v=xdot-u(0). 1PN is pn reference-1PN (AN EXTERNAL REFERENCE TERM FOR COMPARISON, not derived from DFM) with pnVelocity v. NOT A CALIBRATION (sampleClass principle; not a verdict row).
descStruct.observe: CURRENT (wave 297a; harness tests/exp-w297a-refit.mjs, part geotoy): the period (same-direction revolution 2) of the pn-off legacy mesh differs from side B (geoPN=2, lambda_PN=0) by −6.63×10⁻⁶ s (dt) and −1.50×10⁻⁵ s (dt/2). What follows is the record of the declaration until wave 296 (pn reference-1PN, lambda_PN=1) - measured (harness tests/exp-w280c-geo3.mjs, the same extractor as the official judge, the same 20694498-step window): the period (same-direction revolution 2) is 551864.0619249 s, differing from the kF0 diagnostic copy (geoPN=2, lambda_PN=1 - remeasured with the same extractor it reproduces the official kF0 row bit for bit) by +5.62×10⁻⁴ s at dt=0.016 and +5.53×10⁻⁴ s at dt/2. With pnVelocity xdot the difference is +6.98×10⁻⁹ s / −9.22×10⁻⁶ s; pn off against the no-1PN control (lambda_PN=0) differs by −2.57×10⁻⁸ s / −9.15×10⁻⁶ s. The 1PN term itself (lambda_PN 1 minus 0) is +1.73×10⁻⁶ s. One external point source under mutual 0 gives a uniform u (J=0), so the transport is equal for both bodies and the canonical term vanishes (wave 279c).

(1) 'CONNECTING THE MESH CHANGES SOMETHING' DID NOT COME OUT: the gravity channel shares its kernel with E4, so connecting it moves the orbit only at the bit level — and that IS the claim of this sample. (5) D0pull is a declared 'weight of the background', not a calibrated number. (6) NO CLAIMS WINDOW IS DECLARED. (7) 2D with spin=0: tidal locking and rotation are not measured. (8) THE WAVE-255a OPT-INS (weave, reservoir) ARE DECLARED BY NO BUILT-IN PRESET - the five-step row is a harness measurement made by swapping the declaration. The 'substitute the frame' candidate (weave:"pairFull") DESTROYS the binary (r out 200x, 795k clamps) and is kept only as a negative control. The rotor exchange's Q is HEAT, not gravitational-wave emission.
failureFirst.pass: TWO OF REPORT 46's THREE SENTENCES CAME OUT CLEANLY. (1) 'THE FORCE THAT ACCELERATES ALONG THE GRADIENT OF THE MESH OF THE DETERMINACY FIELD IS GRAVITY' IS ALREADY TRUE HERE: the mesh scalar D_grav = sum m/sqrt(d^2+eps^2) has the same kernel as the engine's E4 = G grad W, so replacing one by the other leaves the orbit unchanged to ~1e-19. The mesh's gravity is not a new force; it is another name for the gravity already present. (2) 'BRING D0 CLOSE TO ZERO AND THE MESH ROTATES WITH THE ORBIT' IS A STATEMENT ABOUT chi: the node mesh's rotation rate equals the orbital rate identically, independent of D0, and what D0 moves is the blending weight chi. (3) THE DISPLAY WAS SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT: linearly blending COORDINATES collapses the lattice (det = 1-2chi(1-chi)(1-cos theta)), so that was withdrawn in favour of two modes — a reference guide (chi as opacity) and a transported material line, which tracks the vertices to 1e-15.

raw.description: **第46報「空間メッシュ本体」を測れる形にした原理サンプル**(第254便a)。等質量の 2 体(m=500・半径 1・e=0.5・遠点分離 240)を、**1PN を切って(geoPN=0)引きずり(kFrame=1・A8/E6′)だけ**で回し、そこへ **physics.spaceMesh={mode:"vertex", gravity:true}** を 1 行足す。足したのは「決定力場の空間メッシュの勾配で加速する力」で、そのスカラーは D_grav=Σm/√(d²+ε²)(Φ=−G·D_grav・g=+G·∇D_grav)。**これはエンジンの E4=G∇W と同じ核**なので、足しても軌道は丸めの水準でしか動かない —— それが本サンプルの主張である。格子は**輸送された物質線**(dx/dt=u・dF/dt=(∇u)F を S.step の時刻で RK4 積分したもの)で、公転に随伴して回るのが見える。**この系を見て決めた係数は 1 つも無い**。実測(dt=0.004・器は tests/exp-w254a-meshforce.mjs)。**A/B(spaceMesh の有無)**: 150 万步(t=6000)で近点間 P=**1339.718898**・近点移動 **+2.027112°/周** がどちらも印字桁で同一。1 步の加速度差 |Δa_g| は **0〜2.8×10⁻¹⁸**、150 万步後の状態差は **3.3×10⁻¹⁰**(|r|≈10² に対して)= 丸めの蓄積である。帳簿 spaceMeshWorkE=**1.0×10⁻¹⁶**(gravity チャネルは保存力なので外部仕事を持たない)。**χ の D0pull 依存**(t=0 値): 0→**1(厳密)**・mode=T2・unique=true/1e−4→0.98861(T2・unique)/1e−2→0.46468(blend)/1→0.0086059/1e3→8.680×10⁻⁶。同じ 5 段の**近点間 P** は 793.16/1339.84/888.41/531.56/518.87(ケプラー 518.8544)・**近点移動** +0.6009/+2.0274/+62.86/+12.11/+0.0124°/周。**Ω_mesh 対 Ω_orbit は 5 段すべてで恒等的に一致**する(頂点契約 —— メッシュの回転は D₀ に依らない)。**輸送線の累積回転角/公転角**は 1.0000004〜1.0000010。**物質線の頂点追従**(相対・100 万步): 幾何整合補間 **8.6×10⁻¹³** 対 速度補間 **8.9×10⁻⁵**。NaN 0・D0pull=1e−4 では安全クランプ 0(D0pull=0 の極では 100 万步で 199 万回)。ワンタップ対照A/B: B 側は **spaceMesh なし** — **見た目も数値も変わらない**。それが測った結果である(メッシュの重力は既にある重力であって、二重に数えるものではない)。表示トグル「空間メッシュ」で格子を消せる(直下の「引きずりの度合」で歪みの強さを変えられる — 表示専用)。physics.D0pull を 0 にすると χ=1 の極(互いだけが基準・ただし安全クランプが 100 万步で 199 万回)へ、10³ にすると格子が背景に貼り付く(P=518.87 = ケプラー 518.8544 の +0.003%)。physics.kFrame を 0 にすると引きずりが消えてケプラー楕円に戻る。timeScale=1(1 公転≈1440步)・dispMag=3(表示専用)。🫂 と並べると「同じ引きずりチャネルを、D₀ の掃引で見るか・メッシュの接続で見るか」の対照になる。
